title: Templars and the secrets of time travel

tellings.quote: Templars supposedly had the secrets of time travel you know if you read the Umberto eeko Fuko pendulum

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions the Knights Templar, a religious order of knights from the Middle Ages. He says the Templars supposedly held the secrets of time travel, pointing to Foucault's Pendulum, a novel by the Italian writer Umberto Eco, as a place where this idea appears. It is told as one more thread in old stories of hidden knowledge.
